title: Smoke and Mirrors: Animated Gradient Art with SVG Filters
description: This project showcases a mesmerizing animated gradient effect using advanced CSS and SVG filters. The design features a golden border with a dynamic, smoke-like gradient animation inside. The gradient transitions smoothly between colors using CSS custom properties (@property) and is enhanced by an SVG turbulence filter for a smoky, organic feel. The animation is achieved through keyframes that manipulate custom properties, creating a visually captivating experience.
shortDescription: A stunning animated gradient effect with a smoky texture, powered by CSS custom properties and SVG filters.
